observations: Photo 0 shows a large rectangular solar panel with a black surface and white grid lines separating individual cells.
The panel has a silver or white frame around the edges.
There is a watermark 'SUNCITY SOLAR ENERGY' across the center of the panel.
The panel appears to be standing upright, leaning against a wall, with a broom and a red chair visible in the background.
No visible brand name or model label is readable on the panel itself in the photo.
The cells are uniform in size and shape, suggesting a standard monocrystalline or polycrystalline design.

risks.if_unproven: Priced as used/refurbished, which reduces value.

Close-up photo of the panel surface under bright light to check for cracks or damage.

response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
